mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS chain_id, c.chain_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.enterprise_id) AS enterprise_count FROM chain c LEFT JOIN chain_node n ON n.chain_id = c.id AND n.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN enterprise_node_rel r ON r.node_id = n.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = r.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.chain_name

SELECT DISTINCT r.node_id FROM enterprise_node_rel r INNER JOIN chain_node n ON n.id = r.node_id AND n.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND n.chain_id = #{chainId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.node_id

SELECT r.node_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.id IS NOT NULL THEN r.enterprise_id ELSE NULL END) AS direct_enterprise_count FROM enterprise_node_rel r INNER JOIN chain_node n ON n.id = r.node_id LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = r.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 WHERE n.chain_id = #{chainId} AND n.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.node_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN n.id = #{nodeId} AND e.id IS NOT NULL THEN r.enterprise_id ELSE NULL END) AS direct_enterprise_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.id IS NOT NULL THEN r.enterprise_id ELSE NULL END) AS total_enterprise_count FROM chain_node n LEFT JOIN enterprise_node_rel r ON r.node_id = n.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = r.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 WHERE n.chain_id = #{chainId} AND n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.node_path LIKE #{nodePathPattern}

SELECT ancestor.id AS node_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.id IS NOT NULL THEN r.enterprise_id ELSE NULL END) AS subtree_enterprise_count FROM chain_node ancestor LEFT JOIN chain_node descendant ON descendant.chain_id = ancestor.chain_id AND descendant.node_path LIKE CONCAT(ancestor.node_path, '%') AND descendant.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN enterprise_node_rel r ON r.node_id = descendant.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = r.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ancestor.chain_id = #{chainId} AND ancestor.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ancestor.id
mapper.update: UPDATE enterprise_node_rel SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND node_id IN ( SELECT id FROM chain_node WHERE chain_id = #{chainId} AND is_deleted = 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.node_id FROM enterprise_node_rel r INNER JOIN chain_node n ON n.id = r.node_id WHERE r.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND n.chain_id = #{chainId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND n.is_deleted = 0
